title: Predictors of outcome in early onset schizophrenia: a 10-year follow-up study
notes: The only report in F13 whose cohort is not employment-selected and whose employment result is a whole-cohort point prevalence. 23 of 62 employed; the three status categories sum exactly to the 62 surviving interviewees, so 62 is an observed denominator and not merely a reporting base.
